play.comments: A good win in a three-player game on BGA (11-7-6).

I was pretty happy with my placements. Piper had a great OWS setup and I thought was favoured to win. An early 7 put the robber on an 8 wheat that hurt Daniel and I. It sat there for along time and denied us five 8 rolls of wheat before it moved off. Daniel had upgraded to a city so it technically hurt him more. The two 6 wheat hexes were paying out for Piper and Kim and Greer did surprisingly well with no wheat at all at game start. I commented that due to all the missed wheat I thought I was out of the game - I was last to get my first settlement. Daniel managed to get it due to his 2:1 brick port.
I also had the 10 wheat so got a smattering of wheat, but was generally wheat starved and I took a while to get my first settlement up. It was a good settlement which gave me my first access to sheep, doubled my 5 brick and gave a 3:1 port so I started to cook after that. The robber ended up back on the 8 wheat and caused Daniel and I even more angst. I was saved by the 10 wheat which rolled just enough. I guess the rolls started swinging my way because I did manage to win the game - without road or army with 10 straight points on the board. I was planning to get road, but was behind both Daniel and Greer who were fighting for it. I think Greer and Piper had chances to win. Piper bought a dev card the turn before I won and would have won if it was a VP.
On one turn Piper was deciding between a city and devs, I said get devs and she bought just one dev, then 7ed out the next roll. She did not realise that she could buy multiple devs on one turn. I think that was a tough turn for her as if she had bought 2 (or 3) devs, and not 7ed out she'd have been in an even better position.
